_label: Sample protocols written by the team. Check them with your flight surgeon.

sleep_reset.name: sleep reset
steps: Keep the same sleep time tonight.
Write down what is on your mind.
sleep_reset.escalate_if: Sleep stays low for 3 more nights.

light_exposure.name: light exposure routine
steps: Set cabin light to bright white after waking.
light_exposure.escalate_if: Mood keeps falling for 3 more days.

hydration.name: fluid plan
steps: Repeat the stand test in 4 hours.
hydration.escalate_if: You feel faint, or the stand test gets worse.

exercise_adjustment.name: exercise adjustment
exercise_adjustment.escalate_if: You have pain, or load falls for 5 more days.

social_call.name: social call
steps: Share a meal or a 20 minute talk.
social_call.escalate_if: You feel unsafe, or feel worse after 3 days.

breathing.name: breathing exercise
breathing.escalate_if: You have chest pain or feel short of breath.

rest_day.name: rest protocol
rest_day.escalate_if: Temperature keeps rising, or new symptoms start.
